integrity_statement: The manuscript includes a complete analytic proof and standard-library exact-rational numerical checker. The universal theorem is not inferred from sampled parameters. Earlier universal inequality and equality cases are credited; historical-priority uncertainty and lack of independent audit are stated.
scientific_limitations: Only tetrahedra in dimension three, with equal barycentric upper caps, and only positive-volume parameters t>1/4. Formula has no claim about arbitrary truncations, other dimensions, or historical uniqueness.
title: The complete reflected mixed-volume profile of barycentrically capped tetrahedra
